Hey there @tuya, @zlinoliver, @frenck, mind taking a look at this pull request as it has been labeled with an integration (`tuya`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L1342) for? Thanks!

<details>
<summary>Code owner commands</summary>


Code owners of `tuya` can trigger bot actions by commenting:

- `@home-assistant close` Closes the pull request.
- `@home-assistant rename Awesome new title` Renames the pull request.
- `@home-assistant reopen` Reopen the pull request.
- `@home-assistant unassign tuya` Removes the current integration label and assignees on the pull request, add the integration domain after the command.

</details>

Note: the one failing linter is doing a code spellcheck, which is precisely what Tuya is getting wrong with their upstream API response 😅

Looks good from my end, will see if I can spot any easy to review PRs to help with the backlog 🤞

Updated to minimal set of changes.

Any help with where to raise a ticket for Tuya support (Smart life app? github.com/tuya/tuya-home-assistant repo? Device manufacturer?) would be much appreciated.  Didn't find anything useful on the forums.  (Context: The `"cleanning"` string I'm seeing is appearing on iot.tuya.com, so it likely isn't any of the code in between their API and home assistant).

Thanks
Actually I think I have an idea on how to do this in a device-agnostic way.  Will work on that next up, do some testing, and resubmit a bit later
Now fixes this issue in a device-agnostic way: if `DPCode.STATUS` doesn't map to anything meaningful, fall back to looking up (using the same map) via `DPCode.MODE` (smart, wall_follow, etc).

Rebased on latest dev, and tested working as expected.  Please let me know if there is anything else I need to do, or anything you'd prefer was removed from this PR.

And thanks for all the great work across the whole Home Assistant codebase.  Can only imagine what a huge job it is!

I'm aware things get busy, but is there something in particular you're waiting on from me here?
